tools.name: humanmirror_oracle
tools.description: Use HumanMirror Oracle when an application or AI agent needs structured analysis of text, JSON objects, record arrays, or numeric series: data-quality checks, trends, anomalies, summaries, and recommendations. Do not use it as a substitute for professional advice in high-impact decisions. One successful call consumes 1 Oracle credit.

input.description: Text, JSON object, array of records, or numeric series to analyze.

objective.description: Optional analysis objective, for example: detect anomalies, check data quality, identify trends, or summarize structure.

context.description: Optional context that helps interpret the input.
